# IERC4626MultiTokenEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/extensions/ERC4626MultiToken/IERC4626MultiTokenEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IERC4626MultiTokenEvents

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Events for the VaultWithReceipts contract


## Events
### DepositWithReceipt
Emitted when assets are deposited by `caller` and the shares are received by `receiver` on round 'id'


```solidity
event DepositWithReceipt(address indexed caller, address indexed receiver, uint256 id, uint256 assets);
```

### RedeemReceipt
Emitted when shares for round 'id' are redeemed by `caller` and the assets are received by `receiver`


```solidity
event RedeemReceipt(
    address indexed caller, address indexed receiver, address indexed owner, uint256 id, uint256 amount
);
```

### RedeemReceiptBatch
Emitted when shares for rounds 'ids' are redeemed by `caller` on behalf of `owner` and the assets
are received by `receiver`


```solidity
event RedeemReceiptBatch(
    address indexed caller, address indexed receiver, address indexed owner, uint256[] ids, uint256[] amounts
);
```
